versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the self-learning-agent memory system.
- Implements persistent memory using atomic ~350-token knowledge cards with YAML frontmatter, daily raw logs, and a slim master index (~2KB).
- Supports semantic search to retrieve contextually relevant cards across sessions.
- Automates capture of lessons, corrections, preferences, and key facts for agents that wake up memoryless each session.
- Provides structured workflows for capturing, curating, and promoting knowledge, plus periodic memory maintenance guidelines.
